definitions: To harm oneself in an attempt to harm another.
To engage in an act of retaliation that is more detrimental to oneself than to the intended target.
examples: Don't cut nose to spite face by quitting your job just because you dislike your boss.
Refusing to cooperate with the new team leader would be cutting nose to spite face, as it would only make your own work harder.
synonyms: bite off one's nose to spite one's face
